name: Out-of-body (right hemisphere, two coils)
origin: Todd Murphy (8 Coil Shakti OBE recipe, modulated 40 Hz 'obe45' signal); target site after Blanke et al. 2002
summary: Murphy's OBE suggestion in its two-coil form: the 'modulated 40 Hz' (obe45) signal through one coil in front of and below the right ear and one over the right angular gyrus, then sleep about an hour later. The vendor calls the signal untested and gives no session length: 30 min is a project choice. Murphy reports that most OBEs came while users fell asleep after a session.
notes: The vendor: 'An alternative presentation with a chance of inducing and out-of-body experience using this signal might be one coil in front of and below the right ear, and one coil over the angular gyrus on the right side. ... you should consider it as an untested signal' (obe45_consent.htm, 'Modulated 40 Hz Signal'). The one report on the page is for one coil over the angular gyrus. The OBE pages give no session length: 'As with all new signals, begin with short sessions'. This program plays 30 min, a project choice, on FT10 and P6 (this project's reading); the other six channels stay silent. Both coils have the same polarity: the page gives none, though the vendor's coil pairs have one positive and one negative coil (getting_started_basic.htm). The obe45 file is not published. The stand-in is a 40 Hz sine whose phase swings by up to 3 rad every 2 s; it has no published basis (the vendor: 'This signal has a constant tone.'). murphy-shakti-obe-mod40 plays the same signal on six coils. The vendor: 'The correct calibration will be 10mG for either channel, when measured from one coil', with no distance. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At the default 1 uT that is about 56 uT at the coil face: if the vendor's 10 mG (1 uT) is a reading at the coil, this program is up to 56 times stronger. The two-coil form is a suggestion without a report. Blanke et al. 2002 evoked an OBE by electrical stimulation of the right angular gyrus in one patient, not with a weak field. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Stop using the signal if you have trouble finding words. Right-hemisphere-only sessions can bring fear or unease: stop at once on distress. Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history.
setting: Lie down in a dark, quiet room at night. Plan to go to sleep about 1 h (the obe45 page says about 90 min) after the session, with your OBE exercises.
schedule: At most weekly (or every 72 h), never on consecutive days; six sessions, then a 21-day break.
source: Murphy, Out of body experiences and the 8 Coil Shakti https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/rotating/shakti_obe.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: Modulated 40 Hz (obe45) https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/obe45_consent.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: right angular gyrus https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/rangularg.htm ; McTaggart interview with Murphy (2006) https://youtu.be/K-0PHkfvEhg ; Blanke et al. 2002, Nature 419:269 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12239558/ ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
